jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

We're looking for hungry, high-throughput generalist engineers as we scale into the multi-millions over the next 6 months.


About You

We're looking for hungry, high-throughput generalist engineers as we scale into the multi-millions over the next 6 months. You might want to start your own company one day, but aren’t sure what to build yet. You might have spent time at a larger unicorn and want to join a fast growing startup with PMF.

You will:

  • Get a clear view into engineering, product, go-to-market, and the iterative loop that connects all 3

  • Learn the Vertical AI playbook

    • how to embed into an industry, learn the domain, and build LLM-driven workflows to automate it.

    • How to generate demand with modern GTM techniques across B2B and B2C


What You'll Build

  • Voice and SMS agents that automate the 24/7 shift lifecycle (confirmations, clock-ins, notes, last-minute coverage)

  • LLM orchestration across prompt engineering, tool use, context management, and evals that keep agents reliable as we scale

  • Internal ops tooling so our team can monitor agent performance, handle edge cases, and onboard new customers fast

  • Reliability and observability improvements across our voice and messaging infrastructure

  • Full-stack features from data model to API to UI, shipped to real customers within days

Your First 90 Days

  • Month 1: Ship something real. You'll pair-program with the team immediately and ship features within your first week. By the end of month one, you'll own a complete feature from design to production.

  • Month 2: Go deep on the orchestration layer. You'll improve reliability and observability across our voice and messaging stack, and contribute to how we evaluate agent quality at scale.

  • Month 3: Take ownership. You'll scope and lead a feature area yourself, such as a new EHR integration, an improvement to the talent agent product, or better tooling for our ops team.

Our Tech

  • React / TypeScript / Vite on the frontend

  • FastAPI / Python on the backend

  • Postgres (RDS)

  • Twilio for voice and SMS

  • LLMs throughout

  • AWS

  • Linear, Notion

You're a Good Fit If

  • You're a strong generalist who can work across the stack

  • You stay on the cutting edge of AI dev workflows and love using coding agents to automate engineering, observability, and the entire development workflow.

  • You ship fast and iterate based on real usage

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go

  • You've worked with LLMs in production (or are eager to)

  • You want to be early at a company that's growing very quickly


What We Offer

  • Interesting, high-leverage work at a company growing very fast

  • $180k+ base salary with above-market equity

  • Small team where your work ships to customers immediately

  • In-person in NYC - we work in the same room

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses.

jobs.title: Founding Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.


What you'll do

  • Own the user experience across our core operations product and upcoming mobile talent agent

  • Create software that feels great to use

  • Work in fast, iterative cycles

  • Talk to customers, run UX audits, and turn feedback into shipped improvements

  • Translate our core principles into product:

    • Cycle time is key. You ship quickly and iterate

    • Quality matters. Your work stands on its own


Who you are

  • You have 2+ years of experience in product design

  • You've designed production software that real people use

  • You have strong aesthetic instincts and can articulate what makes design good or bad

  • You notice UX everywhere - good and bad - in your daily life

  • You have a portfolio you're proud of


The tools

  • Figma for design

  • Cursor or similar AI tooling for prototyping


What we offer

  • High-leverage work defining the design language of a fast-growing company

  • Competitive salary with above-market equity

  • Small team where your work ships to customers immediately

  • In-person in NYC (Chinatown / LES)

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.


What you'll do

  • Own creative strategy and production for paid and organic social across TikTok, Meta, Instagram, and YouTube

  • Generate high volumes of creative - ads, UGC-style content, clips, hooks - and test relentlessly

  • Build and manage a pipeline of creators, clippers, and freelancers

  • Study what's working in DTC, creator economy, and direct response - then apply it to healthcare

  • Launch and scale campaigns targeting nurses and caregivers for our talent agent product

  • Track performance obsessively and iterate fast based on what converts

  • Stay ahead of platform changes, trends, and formats before they're obvious


Who you are

  • You've run paid social or organic growth and have results to show

  • You understand direct response creative - hooks, retention, CTAs, thumb-stopping visuals

  • You're chronically online and can spot trends before they peak

  • You've worked with creators or built content engines (UGC, clipping, repurposing)

  • You know tools like Whop, Foreplay, Motion, or similar

  • You move fast and can produce volume without sacrificing quality

  • You're scrappy - you can shoot, edit, write copy, and run ads yourself if needed

  • You have taste and strong opinions about what makes creative work


What we offer

  • Own creative for a company growing extremely fast into a massive market

  • Competitive salary with above-market equity

  • Small team where your work directly drives growth

  • In-person in NYC (Chinatown / LES) - we work in the same room

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses.

jobs.title: Biz Ops
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.


About the role

You'll work directly with Justin (CEO) as a force multiplier - making sure the highest-leverage work actually gets done. You'll have visibility into everything: product, sales, customers, investors. You'll sit in the room for the important conversations, then own the follow-through.

The scope changes constantly. One week you're closing out compliance paperwork, the next you're running a customer implementation, the next you're prepping investor materials. You build context fast, figure things out without being told how, and don't let things slip through the cracks.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role for someone early in their career who wants to learn how companies actually get built - by doing the work, not watching it happen.


What you'll do

  • Own the workflows and projects that keep the CEO and company moving

  • Sit in on customer, investor, and partner meetings - prep beforehand, drive follow-up after

  • Manage internal priorities and make sure decisions turn into actions

  • Write key communications on behalf of the CEO

  • Own cross-functional projects that don't fit neatly anywhere else

  • Be the person who makes problems disappear


Who you are

  • 1-3 years in consulting, banking, or a high-output role at a startup

  • Relentless follow-through - you don't drop balls

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - you figure things out

  • Strong written communication

  • High agency, low ego


Nice to have

  • Healthcare or B2B SaaS experience

  • You know what function you eventually want to own


What we offer

  • See how a company gets built from the CEO's vantage point

  • Competitive salary with above-market equity

  • Small team where your work directly moves the needle

  • In-person in NYC (Chinatown / LES) - we work in the same room

  • Path to grow into whatever function fits you as we scale

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America’s home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

Today, we build AI teammates for home care and home health agencies - starting with scheduling workflows that are mission-critical, high-volume, and deeply broken.

About You

  • You are a business-minded engineer who enjoys speaking with customers and thinking through and solving problems end-to-end

  • You might want to start your own company one day, but aren’t sure what to build yet

  • You might have spent time at a silicon valley startup or larger Unicorn and want to join a fast growing startup with PMF. You’re looking for a customer facing, business-focused engineering role that works closely between sales and core engineering

What You’ll Do

  • Interact directly with customers and deliver solutions end to end, from understanding pain points to designing and implementing solutions

  • Work closely with sales and GTM to close deals and activate customers

  • Drive product feedback loops directly back into the product roadmap

First 90 Days

  • Meet customers. You'll jump in on implementations already in progress, join customer calls, and get deep on how homecare scheduling actually works. By the end of month one, you'll own active customer relationships yourself.

  • Iterate independently with customers. You'll be diagnosing and resolving customer issues directly, building quick fixes that unblock go-lives, and delivering small customizations that show agencies Phoebe can work exactly the way they do.

  • Contribute to the product roadmap. You'll identify your first pattern across multiple customers, such a friction point, a repeated request, a recurring workaround, and work with the team to generalize it into a product improvement.

You're a Good Fit If

  • You're a strong generalist (2+ years shipping real products) who can work across the stack

  • You genuinely enjoy speaking with customers

  • You stay on the cutting edge of AI dev workflows and love using coding agents to automate engineering, observability, and the entire development workflow.

  • You're interested in the full product development loop: understanding a problem, building a solution, seeing it used, and iterating

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go

  • You've worked with LLMs in production (or are eager to)

  • You want to be early at a company that's growing very quickly

What We Offer

  • Interesting, high-leverage work at a company growing very fast

  • We offer competitive compensation in line with venture-backed Series A companies

  • Small team where your work ships to customers immediately

  • In-person in NYC - we work in the same room

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe builds AI teammates for home health: the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

The U.S. medical staffing market is $25B+ and growing, with strong demographic tailwinds as America ages. AI is changing how staffing works, and we’re building to lead that transition. As more agencies and caregivers use Phoebe, the platform gets more valuable.

We're growing fast; in the past 6 months we hit over $1M in ARR, and recently raised $9.5M from Slow Ventures and Quiet. We’re a small team, we move fast, and we’re focused on turning early traction into a durable business. We're hiring an AE to help us meet demand.

The Role

Phoebe already has an early sales motion. Your job is to make it consistent and repeatable.

You’ll work closely with our Founding GTM Sales Leader to standardize how we qualify, run discovery, deliver demos, and hand off to close. You’ll own the funnel from first contact through a completed demo: building the frameworks, running the calls, and ensuring the opportunities that move forward are the right ones.

This is a collaborative, high-visibility role with a direct line to the CEO and real input into how Phoebe goes to market.

What You’ll Own

  • Qualification: define and run the framework that determines which opportunities are worth pursuing

  • Discovery: lead structured conversations that surface real pain, confirm fit, and set up each demo to land

  • Demo: run the full demo experience, tailored to each prospect’s workflows and priorities

  • Close: own proposal and close follow through with qualified customers, then deliver clean, well-documented handoffs to the implementation team post-close

  • Outbound prospecting: use tools like Clay and Attio to build targeted sequences and keep the funnel moving

  • Pre-sales collateral: build discovery guides, demo scripts, and objection-handling frameworks that make the motion repeatable

  • GTM partnership: work closely with the founding team to align on qualification criteria and standardize the end-to-end process

Who You Are

You have 2–3+ years in a BDR, SDR, or sales engineering role, including some time at an early-stage startup. You can build process where there isn’t one, and you hold yourself to a high standard in both cold outbound and warm inbound.

  • Experience in a 0-to-1 or early-stage environment; you can point to things you built, not just supported

  • Ownership mindset; you know the numbers, spot the gaps, and fix them

  • Strong live demo skills; you can handle tough questions on the fly and speak credibly with ops leaders and agency executives

  • Sharp discovery; you ask hard questions early and avoid wasting time on bad-fit deals

  • Hands-on with LLMs and tools like Clay and Attio (or you can get up to speed quickly)

  • Strong debrief habits; you document what works and use the data to improve

  • Home care, healthcare or staffing experience is a plus; genuine interest in the space is required

What we Offer

  • Interesting, high-leverage work at a company growing very fast

  • We offer competitive compensation in line with venture-backed Series A companies

  • Small team where your work ships to customers immediately

  • In-person in NYC - we work in the same room

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses

How to apply

Tell us about a demo or discovery process you built or improved: what it looked like before, what you changed, and what happened.

No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Product Deployment & Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America’s home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

Today, we build AI teammates for home care and home health agencies - starting with scheduling workflows that are mission-critical, high-volume, and deeply broken

We are looking for a high-agency operator to help us deploy Phoebe into real customer workflows and build the operating system for how we scale.


About the Role

  • You will own customer deployments from kickoff through successful activation.

  • You will work directly with agency owners, administrators, schedulers, and operators to understand how their business works, map their workflows, train their teams, identify blockers, and drive them to meaningful usage of Phoebe.

  • This is a customer-facing strategy and operations role at the center of how Phoebe scales. You will sit at the intersection of implementation, customer operations, product feedback, and company-building.

  • The goal is simple: help customers get live, get value, and make every deployment faster, cleaner, and more repeatable than the last.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end deployment for new Phoebe customers, from kickoff through successful launch

  • Lead customer onboarding with clear agendas, structured follow-up, and strong command of next steps

  • Work directly with agency operators to understand scheduling workflows, communication patterns, systems, pain points, and operational blockers

  • Train agency owners, administrators, schedulers, and operators on how to use Phoebe in their day-to-day workflows

  • Drive customers toward meaningful activation by ensuring Phoebe is used for real operational work

  • Track launch readiness, open blockers, customer risks, and adoption signals

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to troubleshoot issues and resolve customer blockers

  • Translate repeated customer issues into product feedback, internal process changes, documentation, and playbooks

  • Use customer data, usage signals, and qualitative feedback to identify risk and prioritize interventions

  • Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, and improve the deployment process

  • Help define what excellent customer deployment looks like at Phoebe


What You’ll Need

  • 1–5 years of experience in consulting, banking, operations, technical implementation, or another high-intensity environment

  • Strong ownership and urgency; you follow through without needing to be chased

  • Ability to understand messy operational workflows quickly and turn them into clear plans

  • Strong customer presence; you can lead structured calls, set expectations, and handle objections

  • Excellent written communication; you can turn messy conversations into useful docs, checklists, and internal updates

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot issues and improve the product

  • Data-informed mindset; you can use usage signals, customer feedback, and operational patterns to assess risk

  • High adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity in an early-stage company

  • Willingness to get in the weeds while also improving the system


Who You Are

You are a strong fit if you:

  • Like messy, high-context work

  • Enjoy talking to customers and understanding how their businesses actually operate

  • Can manage many open loops without dropping balls

  • Are practical, organized, and action-oriented

  • Can move between customer calls, internal docs, product feedback, and operational follow-up

  • Want to build a function, not just fill a seat

  • Are energized by turning chaos into systems
jobs.descriptionPlain:
ABOUT PHOEBE

Phoebe is modernizing America’s home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

Today, we build AI teammates for home care and home health agencies - starting with scheduling workflows that are mission-critical, high-volume, and deeply broken



We are looking for a high-agency operator to help us deploy Phoebe into real customer workflows and build the operating system for how we scale.



ABOUT THE ROLE

 - You will own customer deployments from kickoff through successful activation.

 - You will work directly with agency owners, administrators, schedulers, and operators to understand how their business works, map their workflows, train their teams, identify blockers, and drive them to meaningful usage of Phoebe.

 - This is a customer-facing strategy and operations role at the center of how Phoebe scales. You will sit at the intersection of implementation, customer operations, product feedback, and company-building.

 - The goal is simple: help customers get live, get value, and make every deployment faster, cleaner, and more repeatable than the last.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own end-to-end deployment for new Phoebe customers, from kickoff through successful launch

 - Lead customer onboarding with clear agendas, structured follow-up, and strong command of next steps

 - Work directly with agency operators to understand scheduling workflows, communication patterns, systems, pain points, and operational blockers

 - Train agency owners, administrators, schedulers, and operators on how to use Phoebe in their day-to-day workflows

 - Drive customers toward meaningful activation by ensuring Phoebe is used for real operational work

 - Track launch readiness, open blockers, customer risks, and adoption signals

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to troubleshoot issues and resolve customer blockers

 - Translate repeated customer issues into product feedback, internal process changes, documentation, and playbooks

 - Use customer data, usage signals, and qualitative feedback to identify risk and prioritize interventions

 - Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, and improve the deployment process

 - Help define what excellent customer deployment looks like at Phoebe



WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 1–5 years of experience in consulting, banking, operations, technical implementation, or another high-intensity environment

 - Strong ownership and urgency; you follow through without needing to be chased

 - Ability to understand messy operational workflows quickly and turn them into clear plans

 - Strong customer presence; you can lead structured calls, set expectations, and handle objections

 - Excellent written communication; you can turn messy conversations into useful docs, checklists, and internal updates

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot issues and improve the product

 - Data-informed mindset; you can use usage signals, customer feedback, and operational patterns to assess risk

 - High adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity in an early-stage company

 - Willingness to get in the weeds while also improving the system



WHO YOU ARE

You are a strong fit if you:

 - Like messy, high-context work

 - Enjoy talking to customers and understanding how their businesses actually operate

 - Can manage many open loops without dropping balls

 - Are practical, organized, and action-oriented

 - Can move between customer calls, internal docs, product feedback, and operational follow-up

 - Want to build a function, not just fill a seat

 - Are energized by turning chaos into systems

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

Today, we build AI teammates for home care and home health agencies - starting with scheduling workflows that are mission-critical, high-volume, and deeply broken.

We are looking for a high-agency operator to help us find, qualify, and open the next wave of agencies that should be running on Phoebe.

About the Role

TLDR: Help build our BDR foundation with a clear path to AE in 6-9 months.

  • Base: $77k-84k

  • OTE: $110-$120k

  • Founding-BDR band equity

What You'll Do

  • You will play a key role in driving the top of Phoebe's pipeline, focused heavily on the channels that are not being driven by the GTM engineering, sales, and growth team members that you'll be working closely with.

  • You will become an expert on the home care market and its operational pain points, then execute outbound outreach to book qualified meetings with agency owners and operators.

  • You will help define what excellent outbound looks like at Phoebe, then document it for the next BDR as you shift into a full stack selling role within 6-9 months of joining.

What You'll Need

  • 0-3 years of experience in sales, business development, recruiting, fundraising, or another high-volume outbound role

  • Strong work ethic and visible urgency; you make more attempts than people expect

  • Comfort on the phone with cold prospects; you can hold a conversation, ask sharp questions, and handle objections

  • Strong written communication; your emails sound like a person, not a template

  • Curiosity about how businesses actually run; you want to understand the agency operator, not just sell them

  • Comfort being measured on activity and outcomes

  • High adaptability; you are excited to test, get rejected, and try a different angle the same afternoon

  • Willingness to work in the weeds while also improving the system

Who You Are

You are a strong fit if you:

  • Are competitive and want to be measured against a number

  • Like the grind of cold outbound and don't need constant external motivation

  • Pay close attention to detail (account research, CRM hygiene, follow-through)

  • Take feedback well and try the new thing the next day

  • Want to learn how to sell from the ground up, not just hit a quota

  • Are energized by being early; you'd rather build the playbook than inherit one

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Phoebe is building a network of AI agents to coordinate the in-home care market, one of the biggest labor forces in the country.

We have found product-market fit and we are scaling fast. We are hiring a founding talent partner to help us build out our team across all functions.

You'll take full ownership of recruiting across engineering, GTM, and leadership, treating every open role as a business problem to solve with a direct contribution to what Phoebe becomes.

Read about Phoebe and our hiring philosophy here


What Success Looks Like

  • Within 30 days, own a live search end-to-end, starting with engineering, the spine of our hiring. Source, screen, and drive it to close.

  • Within 90 days, build the machine: ATS, scorecards, screening filters, pipeline reporting, and a weekly operating cadence. Everything the team needs to run hiring on a system instead of in the founder's head.

  • Over the next 6 months, land the hires that matter: the leadership roles and senior engineers. Engage external firms you drive rather than just hire. As the repeatable parts get systematized, your time moves up to the hardest searches.


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience at a mix of agency and fast-growing, product-driven companies, tilt toward either technical, or GTM is fine

  • Hunters. You find the person who isn't looking and you don't stop until they say yes. Posting a req and praying isn't your style, and you'd never outsource the chase.

  • Operational excellence. You get results out of people who don't report to you. You drive external firms hard, hold them accountable, and make them deliver on your timeline.

  • High agency, low ego. You own the outcome end to end, and no part of the job is beneath you. When unglamorous coordination moves a hire, you just do it.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for interns for Fall or Winter (September 2026 - December 2026) and (January 2027 - April 2027). We can also accommodate different periods of time and sponsor Visa's if needed.

Feel free to apply if you're interested in UI/UX or are looking for a ML research intern role as well!

About Phoebe

Phoebe is modernizing America's home healthcare infrastructure. This is the coordination layer for one of the largest labor markets in the country.

We're looking for hungry, high-throughput generalist engineers as we scale into the multi-millions over the next 6 months.


About You

We're looking for hungry, high-throughput generalist engineers as we scale into the multi-millions over the next 6 months. You might want to start your own company one day, but aren’t sure what to build yet. You might have spent time at a larger unicorn and want to join a fast growing startup with PMF.

You will:

  • Get a clear view into engineering, product, go-to-market, and the iterative loop that connects all 3

  • Learn the Vertical AI playbook

    • how to embed into an industry, learn the domain, and build LLM-driven workflows to automate it.

    • How to generate demand with modern GTM techniques across B2B and B2C


What You'll Build

  • Voice and SMS agents that automate the 24/7 shift lifecycle (confirmations, clock-ins, notes, last-minute coverage)

  • LLM orchestration across prompt engineering, tool use, context management, and evals that keep agents reliable as we scale

  • Internal ops tooling so our team can monitor agent performance, handle edge cases, and onboard new customers fast

  • Reliability and observability improvements across our voice and messaging infrastructure

  • Full-stack features from data model to API to UI, shipped to real customers within days

 

Your First 90 Days

  • Month 1: Ship something real. You'll pair-program with the team immediately and ship features within your first week. By the end of month one, you'll own a complete feature from design to production.

  • Month 2: Go deep on the orchestration layer. You'll improve reliability and observability across our voice and messaging stack, and contribute to how we evaluate agent quality at scale.

  • Month 3: Take ownership. You'll scope and lead a feature area yourself, such as a new EHR integration, an improvement to the talent agent product, or better tooling for our ops team.

 

Our Tech

  • React / TypeScript / Vite on the frontend

  • FastAPI / Python on the backend

  • Postgres (RDS)

  • Twilio for voice and SMS

  • LLMs throughout

  • AWS

  • Linear, Notion

 

You're a Good Fit If

  • You're a strong generalist who can work across the stack

  • You stay on the cutting edge of AI dev workflows and love using coding agents to automate engineering, observability, and the entire development workflow.

  • You ship fast and iterate based on real usage

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go

  • You've worked with LLMs in production (or are eager to)

  • You want to be early at a company that's growing very quickly


What We Offer

  • Interesting, high-leverage work at a company growing very fast

  • Above market salary

  • Small team where your work ships to customers immediately

  • In-person in NYC - we work in the same room

  • Multiple second-time founders to learn from - Justin (CEO) sold Bayes (YC S19) to Airtable. Dave built and sold Kamana, an app for travel nurses.
